implementation_policies: A cached headless query reuses the actual locked-cell guard and effective style/grant coverage. Only unambiguous covering password ranges with supported, valid authoritative verifier metadata become candidates. Querying does not mutate source/history/grants.

OPC PasswordVerifier::validate checks metadata without spin iterations: algorithm, digest/base64 sizes, salt/spin bounds and legacy spelling. Existing password verification remains authoritative and unchanged.

Shared pending state binds workbook Arc/Weak session identity, worksheet part, layout revision, complete range definitions, original cell/text and selected original candidate. Replacement documents, sheet roundtrips, protection/history changes, changed entry/cell or public-name retargeting cannot authenticate the pending request.

Manual range managers also require the same workbook session identity. Pending automatic dialogs hide range-management/relock controls, list only valid covering alternatives and use existing localized masked password fields.

Native and browser ordinary commit handlers open the prompt only after protected-cell refusal, retain CellEdit, and validate it again before authenticating. Wrong password/cancel does not change entry, source, history, layout revision or dirty state.

Successful authentication is session-only; it closes the prompt and retries the original matching editor through the normal commit path. Existing validation, formula parsing, recalculation, copy clearing and undo grouping remain in authority. Range grants are unsaved and do not remove sheet protection.
Passwordless/unlocked/already-granted coverage does not prompt. Passwordless descriptors retain the standard everyone-can-edit behavior; no account/domain identity authentication was added.

Automatic prompts currently cover typed single-cell commits, including their formula-bar path. Compound/paste/clear/fill prompts and interrupted navigation replay remain open; those operations retain existing guarded refusals/manual authentication.
